findings.summary: logTail() redacts only the secret from deps.env[AI_SDLC_WEBHOOK_SECRET]. When unset at tick time, the secret read from the installed agent file (plistSecret) is not passed to readLogTail, so a bare secret elsewhere in the log would reach the escalation body. Unlikely; fix is to also pass the agent file's secret.
